title: Consumer Tiers, Business Tiers and the Seats Each Carries
content:
## One market side to a profile

A consumer tier and a business tier of Northbeam Circle Membership are never held at the same time on one
profile, and a profile carrying a business name and a tax exempt certificate is enrolled only on a
business tier. The account type recorded on the profile, the business name recorded on it and the tax
exemption certificate filed against it are read from the profile itself before the enrolment is taken; a
caller's description of the business does not stand in their place.

## Seats belong to the side of the house they come from

Household seats are a consumer-tier arrangement and business seats a business-tier arrangement; neither
kind of seat may be attached to the other kind of tier.

## A business run from the household address

A customer who runs a business from the household address chooses one arrangement: the household tier,
whose seats must share the primary member's service address, or a business tier, whose seats are named
buyers of the business.

## Where both are asked for at once

Where both kinds of enrolment are asked for on one profile the business tier is opened and the consumer
enrolment is refused, because the tax exempt certificate governs how the profile is invoiced.

## Cases

| What the profile carries | What may be opened |
|---|---|
| Consumer account type, no business name | A consumer tier |
| Business account type and a business name | A business tier |
| A business name and a tax exempt certificate | A business tier only |
| Both kinds of enrolment asked for at once | The business tier is opened, the consumer enrolment refused |

A household member asking for 3 household seats on a business tier is asking for an
arrangement that tier does not carry, and a business buyer asking for named business seats on a household tier likewise.
